tools.name: revit_jobs
tools.description: List recent jobs, or wait up to wait_seconds (0 to 50, default 40) for the result of an action jobId. Results stay on the workstation for 24 hours, across server restarts. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_compare_link_datums
tools.description: Compare host grids and levels with one loaded Revit link. Changes nothing. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_ping
tools.description: Check the connection to Revit without reading the model. Returns data="pong", even when no document is active. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_nwc_settings_check
tools.description: Parse a Navisworks exporter XML file on the Revit workstation without exporting. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

fileSystem.scope: Navisworks exporter XML on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_document_info
tools.description: Read the active model's file name, Revit version, levels (elevations in mm), area schemes, worksets and view count. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_documents
tools.description: List every open document in one Revit process, including background documents. Linked documents are listed only when include_linked is set. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_ui_state
tools.description: Read the active document, open views, selection and open documents. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_model_snapshot
tools.description: Read a schema version 1 project snapshot for batch audits. Closed worksets can make the result incomplete. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_model_health
tools.description: Read model quality counts: project metadata, file size, counts, units and the ten most frequent warning groups. Unavailable metrics are null and listed in skipped. output_path also writes an .xlsx health report with up to five snapshots. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

fileSystem.scope: Optional workbook at save_to on the client.

tools.name: revit_links_status
tools.description: Read RVT, CAD and image link status. Each list is capped at 100 entries; summary counts cover all links. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_shared_coordinates
tools.description: Read project and survey coordinates: base and survey points, active site, project locations and link offsets (mm, degrees). Lists are capped at 100 with total counts. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_parameter_fill_check
tools.description: Count filled, empty and missing parameters per parameter and category, with samples of empty and missing element IDs. Numeric zero counts as filled. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_list_catalog
tools.description: List catalog names for one section: categories, family-types, levels, area-schemes, views, worksets, phases or parameters. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_aggregate_elements
tools.description: Summarize matching elements by one or two fields, with optional sum and average. Lengths use mm, areas m2, volumes m3. For area totals, group by level and select the area scheme. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_query_elements
tools.description: Read a page of matching element rows. Lengths use mm, areas m2, volumes m3; optional geometry is in model mm. roomCenterMm is a point inside the room, a bounding-box centre can lie outside it. hasMore=true means further pages exist. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_list_views
tools.description: List non-template views with id, name, type, level, scale and template. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_view_info
tools.description: Inspect one view's template, display, categories, worksets, filters and links. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_view_summary
tools.description: Read element categories and counts for a selected view. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_schedule_data
tools.description: Read displayed schedule header and body cell text, with paging. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_capture_elements
tools.description: Save a PNG picture marking 1 to 500 elements in a folder the user names through output_path, or in a temporary folder when omitted. Existing files are refused. Supports 3d or plan mode over local or SSH transport. The temporary view is rolled back. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

fileSystem.scope: PNG at save_to or a temporary directory on the client.

tools.name: revit_export_view
tools.description: Save a picture of the selected view as a PNG file in a folder the user names on the AI app computer. output_path names the new file; without it, a temporary folder is used. Existing files are refused. The active view and model stay unchanged. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

fileSystem.scope: PNG at save_to or a temporary directory on the client.

tools.name: revit_view_elements
tools.description: Read one page of elements in a selected view, with IDs, category, family, type, level and measurements (mm, m2, m3). A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_element_details
tools.description: Read parameters and geometry of an element by Revit ID, with its type parameters and related warnings. Geometry is in model mm; roomCenterMm is a point inside the room. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_view_warnings
tools.description: Read warnings involving elements present in a selected view. A warning may also involve elements outside the view. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_list_warnings
tools.description: Group model warnings by description text. warning_text with include_elements=true returns the elements of one group. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_list_relations
tools.description: Read model object membership or dependencies. relation is level-rooms, area-scheme-elements or view-template-dependents (with source_name), or group-elements or nested-family (with source_id). A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_list_instances
tools.description: List Revit processes with documentName, documentPath, revitVersion, processId and pluginResponding. Busy or unresponsive processes stay listed with pluginResponding=false. HTTP mode reports only its connected process.

tools.name: revit_family_audit
tools.description: Audit an open family or named project families without saving or loading changes. Project mode takes exact family names or ["*"]; family mode takes none. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

tools.name: revit_open_document
tools.description: Open a local, UNC or RSN model. Central models open detached by default. Cloud paths are unsupported. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.

fileSystem.scope: Model file on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_activate_document
tools.description: Activate an already open document by title or path reference.

tools.name: revit_activate_view
tools.description: Activate a non-template view. Zoom to fit, preserve zoom, or frame element IDs.

tools.name: revit_close_views
tools.description: Close open UI views in the active document.

tools.name: revit_new_document
tools.description: Create a project or family from a template on the Revit workstation.

fileSystem.scope: Optional save_as path on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_close_document
tools.description: Close a background document. Needs confirm_token from a first call, which changes nothing.

confirmation.condition: Closing with save=true, or closing a modified document without saving.

tools.name: revit_save_document
tools.description: Save a document. Needs confirm_token from a first call, which changes nothing.

fileSystem.scope: Model path on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_sync_document
tools.description: Synchronize a workshared document with central. Needs confirm_token from a first call, which changes nothing.

confirmation.condition: Every call; a non-empty comment is required.

fileSystem.scope: Local copy and central model on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_set_view_visibility
tools.description: Change category, workset and filter visibility in one view; dry_run previews. Categories accept the Revit UI name, the BuiltInCategory name (OST_StructuralColumns), the English name or an ID.

tools.name: revit_remove_links
tools.description: Delete selected link types and their instances; dry_run previews. Cannot be undone in Revit. Needs confirm_token from a first call, which changes nothing.

confirmation.condition: Every call except dry_run; removal cannot be undone in Revit.

tools.name: revit_execute_code
tools.description: Compile and run C# against the live Revit API on the Revit thread. Accepts a method body or a public static Script class with Execute(ScriptContext ctx). Auto mode owns one transaction and undo entry; transaction="none" is refused by default. Needs confirm_token from a first call, which runs nothing; dry_run needs none. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.

fileSystem.scope: Not restricted by the server; enabled C# runs with the user's rights.

tools.name: revit_undo_last
tools.description: Undo the last MCP action through Revit's own undo command. Runs only when the target document is active, no command is pending and Revit's last undo entry is the one this session recorded; otherwise the result carries a refusal reason.

tools.name: revit_align_link_datums
tools.description: Align host grids and levels to a loaded link, with optional creation and rollback preview. Does not create a monitor relationship.

tools.name: revit_cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of an action jobId. Process-models stops before the next model and marks unstarted models cancelled; a single running Revit operation finishes, and completed changes stay committed.

tools.name: revit_select
tools.description: Select element IDs for inspection in Revit; an empty list clears the selection.

tools.name: revit_show
tools.description: Display elements in Revit, optionally selecting them; opens a level plan or 3D view when needed.

tools.name: revit_isolate
tools.description: Temporarily isolate element IDs in the active view; an empty list resets.

tools.name: revit_move
tools.description: Move elements by dx_mm, dy_mm and dz_mm on model axes. dry_run rolls back and returns the verification block. Group members, pinned, hosted and constrained elements are reported in skipped.inGroup, skipped.pinned, skipped.hosted and skipped.constrained and are not changed; the call is refused if every element is a group member.

tools.name: revit_override_graphics
tools.description: Colour elements in selected model views; reset restores overrides saved in this Revit session.

tools.name: revit_rotate
tools.description: Rotate elements about a vertical axis through center_mm, or through their combined bounding box center. dry_run rolls back. Group members, pinned, hosted and constrained elements are reported in skipped.inGroup, skipped.pinned, skipped.hosted and skipped.constrained and are not changed; the call is refused if every element is a group member.

tools.name: revit_copy
tools.description: Create 1 to 100 successive copies at multiples of the model-axis offset in mm. dry_run rolls back. Group members are reported in skipped.inGroup; the call is refused if every element is a group member.

tools.name: revit_mirror
tools.description: Mirror across a model X or Y parallel line through point_mm; copy keeps originals. dry_run rolls back. Group members, pinned, hosted and constrained elements are reported in skipped.inGroup, skipped.pinned, skipped.hosted and skipped.constrained and are not changed; the call is refused if every element is a group member.

tools.name: revit_change_type
tools.description: Change each element to one compatible type; family resolves duplicate type names. dry_run rolls back. Group members are reported in skipped.inGroup; the call is refused if every element is a group member.

tools.name: revit_update_parameters
tools.description: Update a parameter on elements matching the same filters as revit_query_elements. Group members are reported in skipped.inGroup instead of failing the call; dry_run predicts this.

tools.name: revit_place_family
tools.description: Place a loaded unhosted family on a named level. family is a name or Family: Type; a null type_name uses the embedded or first type. XY is in mm, rotation in degrees.

tools.name: revit_load_family
tools.description: Load workstation .rfa files in one undo entry. Existing families are skipped unless overwrite is true.

fileSystem.scope: Family files (.rfa) on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_place_families
tools.description: Load optional families and place instances in one transaction and undo entry.

tools.name: revit_create_wall
tools.description: Create a straight wall on a named level. XY endpoints and height are in mm; a null wall_type uses the first basic type.

tools.name: revit_create_mep_run
tools.description: Create connected duct, pipe, cable tray or conduit segments from model mm points. A missing Z uses the level elevation plus the kind's default offset. Unplaceable elbows are reported as unjoined pairs.

tools.name: revit_link_cad
tools.description: Link or import a DWG into a plan view on the Revit workstation. Returns CAD layers and extents in mm.

fileSystem.scope: DWG file on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_walls_from_cad
tools.description: Bridge openings, pair parallel CAD lines and join basic walls in one undo entry. Dimensions are mm. Joins Revit rejects are left out and reported as unjoinedEnds with unjoinedReasons; dry_run reports the same join numbers.

tools.name: revit_create_view
tools.description: Create a plan, section, 3D or drafting view. Unbounded 3D views show the whole model, shaded, fine detail. Box coordinates are model mm.

tools.name: revit_duplicate_view
tools.description: Duplicate a view, optionally with detailing or as a dependent view.

tools.name: revit_apply_view_template
tools.description: Apply a matching view template to one or more views.

tools.name: revit_create_sheet
tools.description: Create a sheet with the first loaded or a named title block.

tools.name: revit_place_views_on_sheet
tools.description: Place views and schedules on a sheet. Coordinates are sheet mm.

tools.name: revit_tag_elements
tools.description: Tag elements in a view, chosen by category names or by element IDs (exactly one of the two). Returns created tag IDs in createdElementIds; already tagged elements are skipped unless skip_tagged is false, and untaggable inputs are listed in skipped. tag_type matches a tag type name, a family name or "Family: Type"; the default tag type is used otherwise. Room tags need a plan view. dry_run rolls back and returns the tags that would be created.

tools.name: revit_create_schedule
tools.description: Create a schedule for one category with the named fields in the given order, using Revit UI names such as Mark, Level or Count. filters keep rows by field, operator and value; sort orders and, with header or footer, groups rows. Lengths in mm, areas in m2, volumes in m3. itemized=false collapses identical rows. Returns viewId and the resolved fields; unknown names are listed in skipped. dry_run rolls back.

tools.name: revit_set_parameter
tools.description: Set one instance or type parameter. parameter_id selects by BuiltInParameter name, shared GUID or ParameterElement ID; otherwise parameter takes a localized UI name, BuiltInParameter name or English alias, and ambiguous matches are refused. Value is a string, integer or number by storage type; lengths in mm, areas in m2. Group members fail with a clear message. dry_run rolls back and returns the verification block.

tools.name: revit_delete
tools.description: Delete elements and their Revit dependencies; the count includes dependents. dry_run returns the count. Above 500 elements including dependents a confirm_token from a first call is needed; revit_run_actions refuses such deletions.

confirmation.condition: A real deletion of more than 500 elements, dependents included.

tools.name: revit_export
tools.description: Save PDF, DWG, IFC or schedule CSV files to a folder the user names with output_dir on the Revit workstation; dry_run returns planned file names. Replacing existing files (overwrite=true) uses a two-step confirm_token handshake with the AI app. The AI app is expected to show the action to you; Model MCP does not show its own dialog. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.

confirmation.condition: overwrite=true and at least one target file already exists.

fileSystem.scope: Export folder on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_export_nwc
tools.description: Save an NWC file to a folder the user names through path on the Revit workstation; needs the Navisworks exporter. settings_xml applies exporter XML values, explicit arguments take precedence. Replacing an existing file (overwrite=true) uses a two-step confirm_token handshake with the AI app. The AI app is expected to show the action to you; Model MCP does not show its own dialog. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.

confirmation.condition: overwrite=true and the target file already exists.

fileSystem.scope: NWC file path on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_run_actions
tools.description: Execute up to 50 actions with one undo step; the whole batch rolls back on its first failure. dry_run rolls back and returns the verification block.

tools.name: revit_process_models
tools.description: Open each model in the interactive session, run steps and C# code, export, save as requested, and close. In-place saves and code need a confirm_token from the preview response. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.

confirmation.condition: In-place saves, and code without dry_run.

fileSystem.scope: Model files, export folders and saved copies on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_edit_families
tools.description: Edit an open family in place, or named project families (exact names or ["*"]), one load cycle each. A dry run rolls back all changes. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.

tools.name: revit_batch_start
tools.description: Start a persistent, read-only run over local, UNC or RSN models. open_timeout_minutes is the per-model open deadline (default 30, 45 when upgrading in memory).

fileSystem.scope: Model files and durable batch state on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_batch_status
tools.description: Read durable run and model status after the initiating client exits.

tools.name: revit_batch_cancel
tools.description: Persist cancellation and prevent unstarted models from running.

fileSystem.scope: Cancellation state on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_batch_fetch
tools.description: Download completed snapshots to new local files without overwriting.

fileSystem.scope: New snapshot files on the client; existing files are not overwritten.

tools.name: revit_build_report
tools.description: Build a local Excel report from snapshots without contacting Revit.

fileSystem.scope: Reads snapshot directories and writes an .xlsx report on the client.

tools.name: revit_issue_register
tools.description: Write a new local .xlsx issue register with element snapshots and review documents. Takes 1 to 60 issues; captures at most 25 snapshots (by severity) within a 210-second budget, and failed snapshots become cell notes. Snapshots need local or SSH transport. Existing output files are refused. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

fileSystem.scope: New .xlsx file at output_path on the client.

resources.name: coordinator_guide
resources.description: Guide for reviewing a Revit model: tool order, result fields and reporting conventions.

prompts.name: model_overview
prompts.description: Review one open model: health, warnings, links, coordinates and families, as a findings table.

prompts.name: pre_issue_check
prompts.description: Check an open model before issuing it: health, warnings, links, coordinates, parameter fill and families.

prompts.name: warnings_triage
prompts.description: Group and prioritize model warnings with affected element IDs.

prompts.name: parameter_fill_report
prompts.description: Report how completely the requested parameters are filled for the requested categories.

prompts.name: batch_audit
prompts.description: Collect snapshots from many models in the background and build a comparison report.

externalEndpoints.purpose: Check for the latest stable release at most once every 24 hours after Revit starts.
externalEndpoints.dataSent: None beyond a standard HTTPS request; no model data.
externalEndpoints.disable: Install with UPDATEMODE=off (or UPDATECHECK=0), set updateMode to off in settings.json, or build with UpdateChannel=managed.

externalEndpoints.purpose: Download the release MSI and its SHA256 checksum when an update is available; the checksum is verified before install.

apisUsed: Revit API (read access to the open document through ExternalEvent)
Revit API (element, view, sheet, link and family changes, each in one named transaction)
Revit API (document open, save, synchronize and close)
Revit API (PDF, DWG, IFC and schedule CSV export)
Navisworks NWC Export Utility (optional, only for revit_export_nwc)

dataHandling.aiClients: The server does not call any AI service. Tool results go to the MCP client the user chose; that client may send them to its own model provider under the user's own agreement.
dataHandling.readOnlyMode: Actions are refused when REVIT_MCP_READ_ONLY=1 or the workstation read-only file exists.
dataHandling.localChannels: Named pipe (current Windows user only), a file channel under %LOCALAPPDATA%\RevitModelMcp, and an HTTP listener bound to 127.0.0.1 with a bearer token. A remote workstation is reached only through a user-configured SSH or HTTP(S) host.
dataHandling.confirmation: confirm_token is a two-step handshake with the AI app. The AI app is expected to show the action to you; Model MCP does not show its own dialog.
